summary: Verified TRC20-only single-channel state end-to-end. Backend GET /api/channels returns EXACTLY ONE channel named 'TRC20 极速通道' (network TRC20, status=active, wallet_addresses=[TN3W4H6rK2ce4vX9YnFQHwKENnHjoxb3m9], 1 address in pool, 8 pending). Admin login works. POST /api/orders succeeds and routes to network TRC20 (single channel is used). Channel count remains 1 after order creation. Frontend /channels renders exactly one channel card with correct metadata; no '大额通道', no TEST_ channels. 5/5 backend pytest assertions pass.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/channels returns channel objects with field 'status' ('active') rather than boolean 'active'; frontend/tests should rely on this.
Address pool is exposed as 'wallet_addresses' (list) plus singular 'wallet_address'; no /api/channels/{id}/addresses endpoint (returns 404). Documentation/consumers should use the embedded list.

Order creation (POST /api/orders) response did not include an explicit routed channel_name field; only network was returned. Consider including routed channel id/name in the response for traceability (helpful for dashboards).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test order via POST /api/orders with remark='TEST_single_channel' (amount 123.45 USDT, TRC20) to verify routing. No channels were created; single-channel state preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Channel is identified by name 'TRC20 极速通道', network TRC20, status 'active'. Address pool via wallet_addresses list on the channel object. Order routing confirmed. If backend seed re-runs on a fresh DB it should only create this one channel.
rca of the issue: N/A — fix verified. Previous multi-channel seed was replaced with single 'TRC20 极速通道' seed; MongoDB cleaned up correctly.
